description: This source file defines the `WrappedException` class used within the Orleans runtime for error reporting and exception handling. The class provides serialization support, message wrapping, and rethrowing capabilities, and serves as a base exception class for Orleans-specific exceptions.

classes.name: WrappedException
classes.description: An exception class used by the Orleans runtime that extends `OrleansException`. It handles serialization, maintains the original exception type, and provides static methods for creating and rethrowing wrapped exceptions.

methods.name: WrappedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message.

methods.name: WrappedException
methods.description: Obsolete constructor for serialization purposes, initializes with serialization info and context.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Serializes the exception data, including the original exception type.

methods.name: CreateAndRethrow
methods.description: Creates a `WrappedException` from an existing exception and rethrows it while preserving the stack trace.

methods.name: CreateFromException
methods.description: Constructs a `WrappedException` from an existing exception, capturing its type and stack trace.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides `ToString` to include the original exception type and message.
